Job Description
At Boeing, we innovate and collaborate to make the world a better place. We’re committed to fostering an environment for every teammate that’s welcoming, respectful and inclusive, with great opportunity for professional growth. Find your future with us.
Boeing Defense, Space and Security (BDS) Mobility, Surveillance & Bombers (MS&B) division is hiring a Business Intelligence Analyst (Level 3) as we expand our division-aligned Business Analytics team to lead and manage the development of analytical tools to increase visibility of program performance and support data-driven decision making. In joining this team, you will have a critical part in the division's analytical transformation including program metric identification and development, KPI standardization and management, and descriptive, diagnostic, predictive, and prescriptive analytics development and deployment. This role will be based in Tukwila, WA .

Strong communication and organizational skills are critical to success in this position, along with the ability to build strong relationships, collaborate in a cross-functional environment, and utilize problem-solving skills to proactively identify and manage risks and opportunities.

Position Responsibilities:
Designs and develops Business Intelligence information models, dashboards, metrics and reports utilizing standard technologies and methodologies. Combines programming, SQL skills, best practices, strategic decision-making capabilities and business expertise to deliver efficient and scalable Business Intelligence solutions to improve engineering processes, engineering performance, business productivity and business outcomes. Data Preprocessing and Cleaning: Ensure the quality and accuracy of large volumes of structured and unstructured data using SQL or other coding languages. Develop ETL pipelines, ensuring high-quality data capture. Supports establishment of strategic direction of descriptive analytics for the division and functional partners, including identifying opportunities for analytical solution development Identify key performance indicators (KPIs) to provide accurate visibility of program and functional performance. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand data requirements and business objectives. Partner with stakeholders and internal customers to ensure follow up action for issue resolution. Clearly articulate technical concepts and information to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Effectively train individuals on how to utilize analytical tools, ensuring clear understanding of the information
This position is expected to be 100% onsite. The selected candidate will be required to work on-site at one of the listed location options.

This position requires the ability to obtain a U.S. Security Clearance for which the U.S. Government requires U.S. Citizenship. U.S. Secret Clearance Post Start is required.)

Basic Qualifications (Required Skills/Experience):
5+ years of experience in identifying and communicating business requirements with cross-functional and/or cross-business teams 3+ years of experience with database technologies using SQL or PL/SQL 3+ years of experience in designing/building visualizations within Tableau Experience with building ETL pipelines 3+ years of experience in data analysis algorithms (e.g. data mining, statistics, machine learning, natural language processing, text mining, visual analytics) and building Descriptive, Predictive and Prescriptive models 3+ years of experience developing and maintaining relationships and partnerships with stakeholders (i.e. customers, suppliers, peers and/or partners) 1+ year of experience working with data supporting engineering functions (Design Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Production Engineering) "3+ years exp working in either Supply Chain, Engineering, Manufacturing or Quality function"

Preferred Qualifications (Desired Skills/Experience):
Master’s degree or higher, study in a technical field (i.e. Computer Science, Information Management, etc.) Understanding of aerospace engineering (design engineering, manufacturing engineering, production engineering) processes and data Experience developing solutions in Palantir Foundry including ontology development, application development, and AIP integration Experience with R or Python Strong Cloud background, specifically in Azure and Azure Managed Services Experience in Dev Ops: CI/CD pipelines
This position is expected to be 100% onsite. The selected candidate will be required to work on-site at one of the listed location options.

Shift:
This position is for 1st shift.

Typical Education/Experience:
Education/experience typically acquired through advanced technical education (e.g. Bachelor) and typically 10 or more years' related work experience or an equivalent combination of technical education and experience (e.g. PhD, Master+3 years' related work experience, 6years' related work experience, etc.)

Conflict of Interest:
Successful candidates for this job must satisfy the Company’s Conflict of Interest (COI) assessment process.

Relocation:
Relocation assistance is not a negotiable benefit for this position. Candidates must live in the immediate area or relocate at their own expense.

Travel:
Position may require travel up to 10% of the time.

Drug Free Workplace:
Boeing is a Drug Free Workplace where post offer applicants and employees are subject to testing for marijuana, cocaine, opioids, amphetamines, PCP, and alcohol when criteria is met as outlined in our policies.

Pay & Benefits:
At Boeing, we strive to deliver a Total Rewards package that will attract, engage and retain the top talent. Elements of the Total Rewards package include competitive base pay and variable compensation opportunities.

The Boeing Company also provides eligible employees with an opportunity to enroll in a variety of benefit programs, generally including health insurance, flexible spending accounts, health savings accounts, retirement savings plans, life and disability insurance programs, and a number of programs that provide for both paid and unpaid time away from work.

The specific programs and options available to any given employee may vary depending on eligibility factors such as geographic location, date of hire, and the applicability of collective bargaining agreements.

Pay is based upon candidate experience and qualifications, as well as market and business considerations.

Summary pay range: $102,850-$139,150

Applications for this position will be accepted until Dec. 04, 2026

Export Control Requirements:
This position must meet U.S. export control compliance requirements. To meet U.S. export control compliance requirements, a “U.S. Person” as defined by 22 C.F.R. §120.62 is required. “U.S. Person” includes U.S. Citizen, U.S. National, lawful permanent resident, refugee, or asylee.

About nLIGHT

At nLIGHT, we are constantly on the cutting-edge of laser technology in a massively growing market. We are a leading provider of high-power semiconductors and fiber lasers for industrial, microfabrication, and aerospace & defense applications, to name a few. Our lasers are changing not only the way things are made, but also changing the things that can be made.

Headquartered in Camas, Washington, nLIGHT is a publicly listed company (NASDAQ: LASR).
Summary
The Business Intelligence Analyst designs, develops, and supports scalable reporting and data solutions across the organization. This role partners with IT and business stakeholders to gather requirements, translate business needs into data-driven insights, and build Power BI reports, semantic models, SQL queries, and data pipelines that support operational and strategic decision-making. The position works closely with the BI Team to maintain consistent data models, improve reporting performance, and support the organization’s modern analytics platform.
Responsibilities:

• Designs, develops, and maintains Power BI datasets and reports, including data modeling, DAX development, and performance optimization.

• Builds and supports data pipelines and ETL processes to ingest, transform, and prepare data for reporting, analytics, and eventual AI ingestion.

• Collaborates with business stakeholders to gather requirements and translates business questions into data-driven insights.

• Works with modern data platforms, such as Microsoft Fabric and Azure-based services, to support data ingestion, transformation, and orchestration workflows.

• Follows established data architecture standards and partners closely with the BI/Data Architect to ensure consistency across data models, pipelines, and reporting solutions.

• Documents data definitions, report logic, and processes to support maintainability and knowledge sharing.

• Supports other data projects and duties as assigned.

Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in a related field and at least 3 years of experience with relational databases, SQL, and reporting or analytics solutions; equivalent combinations of education and experience may be considered.

• Strong SQL skills and understanding of data modeling concepts (e.g., dimensional modeling).

• Experience building interactive reports and semantic models in Power BI, including DAX.

• Familiarity with ETL concepts and data pipeline development.

• Experience with or exposure to cloud-based data platforms (Azure, Microsoft Fabric, or similar).

• Ability to communicate technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

• Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced deadline-driven environment.

• Ability to take direction, accept constructive criticism and be diplomatic when reviewing work of others.

• Knowledge of standard reporting used for manufacturing, finance, and supply chain management.

• Experience with ERP, MES, or HRIS systems (Dynamics 365 a plus).

• Exposure to Power Query, Fabric pipelines, or data lake/lakehouse concepts.

• Familiarity with SOX and other government regulatory reporting environments.

• Demonstrated judgment, discretion, and professionalism, including the ability to handle sensitive information confidentially, maintain appropriate boundaries, and escalate issues when needed.

• Ability to navigate ambiguity, support change, and contribute to process improvements in a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment.

**DSHS FTAA IT Data Management - Senior Specialist**

We are seeking an experienced Epic Senior Business Intelligence Analyst to join our team at the Finance, Technology, Analytics, and Accounting Administration (FTAA) and Division of Enterprise Technology (DIT). This is an amazing opportunity for you to utilize your Epic Caboodle, Cogito, Slicer Dicer, and/or Clarity experience and certificates.

In this role you will be a subject matter expert in Electronic Health Records (EHR), clinical operational workflow context, EHR data models, coding terminology and standards, data privacy and compliance, integration and downstream system context and have Epic specific reporting knowledge. You will also support the reporting and integration of the DSHS EHR product and ensure it aligns with the vision and needs of the Health and Human Services (HHS) Coalition organizations, its staff, business partners, community partners and the 2.9 million Washingtonians served by these coalition organizations statewide.

  

**Some of what you will do:**

* Review and analyze incoming clinical data requests from DSHS and Health Care Management and Coordination Systems (HCMACS) business partners using objective scoring metrics to estimate development effort and prioritize the data backlog for sprint execution
* Translate ambiguous healthcare business requirements into clear, technically sound User Stories, Epics, and Themes within Jira
* Perform quantitative analyses on EHR system usage data using database auditing tools to discover operational workflow bottlenecks, resulting in data-backed feature recommendations for the software development roadmap
* Conceptualize, design, and build automated data visualizations and clinical dashboards
* Conduct rapid-response, ad-hoc statistical analyses on raw EHR datasets during public health emergencies or legislative inquiries
* Write and optimize complex, multi-table SQL queries
* Configure and deploy embedded Epic Cogito reporting tools to deliver real-time data to healthcare workers
* Subject all custom SQL code and dashboards to rigid peer reviews and data validation testing prior to live production deployment
* Evaluate data extraction patterns and user report access lists against HIPAA regulations and state data privacy policies
* Map and audit database schemas against standardized healthcare coding terminologies

**Who should apply?**

A Bachelor’s degree in Health Informatics, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field  
AND  
Seven years of progressively responsible experience in Epic application analysis, configuration, and implementation, including at least two years in a lead or senior capacity.  
OR  
A minimum of eleven years experience progressively responsible experience, with statewide authority and impact, consulting with and providing high level advice to organization leadership regarding the administration of health record management and administration. This includes developing and implementing state policies and operational procedures which are informed by state and federal policies and regulations.  
  
Must demonstrate depth in the following areas:

* Epic & Healthcare Context (minimum two to three years): Direct hands-on experience working in a healthcare delivery setting (such as a hospital, state health authority, or corrections infirmary), with specific experience utilizing Epic’s backend database architecture
* Data Engineering & SQL: A proven track record of writing, tuning, and optimizing multi-table SQL queries against relational or dimensional database schemas
* Agile Framework Delivery: At least 2 years of experience operating directly within an Agile/Scrum software development lifecycle, including experience writing structured user stories, epics, and acceptance criteria in tools like Jira or Azure DevOps
* Data and Reporting Visualization: Proficiency in designing, publishing, and securing production-tier enterprise dashboards using tools like Power BI or Tableau

  
Graduate degrees (such as a Master's degree in Health Informatics, Data Science, or Public Administration) can substitute for up to one to two years of general experience. Conversely, highly relevant professional IT or data engineering experience can substitute year-for-year for the formal degree.  
  

**What we're looking for:**

* Epic Cogito Fundamentals / Tools Admin: Verifies mastery over Epic's front-end reporting suite, including Radar dashboards, Reporting Workbench, and SlicerDicer
* Epic Caboodle Data Model: Verifies the technical ability to query and customize Epic’s pre-aggregated dimensional data warehouse
* Epic Clarity Data Model (Clinical and/or Revenue modules): Verifies deep structural knowledge of Epic's massive relational SQL backend databases
* Business Analysis Professional Certification: Certified Business Analysis Professional (CBAP) or Certification of Capability in Business Analysis (CCBA) to validate Agile requirements gathering skills
* BI Platform Certifications: Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate, or Tableau Desktop Certified Professional

  

**Please include the following:**

* Current chronological resume
* A cover letter explaining why you are interested in the job, your skills, and experience that makes you the best person for the job
* Three professional references with current contact information

  
**Questions?** Please contact [sean.brauner@dshs.wa.gov](mailto:sean.brauner@dshs.wa.gov) and reference #07767.

The Associate Business Intelligence Analyst supports Quality Data Reporting Services by developing, maintaining, and validating reporting and analytics solutions that enable data-driven decision making. This role partners with stakeholders to understand business needs and translate requirements into dashboards, reports, metrics, and visualizations using Power BI and related technologies. The Associate Business Intelligence Analyst is responsible for ensuring the accuracy, reliability, and usability of reporting solutions through data validation, report maintenance, and continuous improvement of reporting environments. This position combines data analysis, report development, stakeholder collaboration, and business intelligence support to deliver actionable insights across the organization.

  

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Partner with stakeholders to gather, analyze, and document business requirements and translate those requirements into reporting and analytics solutions.
* Analyze data using established methods and deliver accurate, actionable, and timely results.
* Design, develop, and maintain Power BI dashboards, reports, and paginated reports.
* Support the modernization, administration, and continuous improvement of Power BI reporting workspaces and reporting environments.
* Create, maintain, and enhance data visualizations, metrics, scorecards, and key performance indicators.
* Validate data sources, datasets, semantic models, cubes, dashboards, and paginated reports to ensure accuracy, consistency, and reliability.
* Review, validate, and clean data; identify and resolve data inconsistencies.
* Support Quality Data Reporting Services through report development, maintenance, and troubleshooting activities.
* Use established data sources and research alternative data sources when needed.
* Collaborate with data owners and stakeholders to improve data quality and update reporting solutions.
* Support validation of reporting data sources, data connections, and related data infrastructure.
* Create and maintain technical documentation related to reporting solutions and data processes.

  

**Required Qualifications:**

* BS degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Information Systems, Computer Science, Business Analytics, Social Sciences, or related experience.
* Knowledge of Microsoft Word, Microsoft Excel, Microsoft Access, and Power BI.
* Basic understanding of data structures, databases, and relational data concepts.
* Ability to gather requirements from stakeholders and translate business needs into reporting and analytics solutions.
* Strong analytical, systems thinking, problem-solving, decision-making, organizational, and project management skills.

  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience developing reports, dashboards, or data visualizations using Power BI or similar business intelligence tools.
* Experience applying statistical skills in a manufacturing, electronics design, or business environment.
* Experience validating data models, reporting solutions, or business intelligence systems.
* Working knowledge of SQL.
* Working knowledge of Python.

  

**Location:**

**Pullman, WA -** This position is located in Pullman, WA. Nestled in Eastern Washington, offering an exceptional quality of life. Embrace the charm of small-town living with spacious surroundings, no traffic hassles, and easy access to outdoor adventures in nearby mountains, rivers, and forests. Plus, benefit from excellent schools and universities in the area.

  

#SEL25

**Competitive pay. Superior benefits. Inspiring work.**

People are at the core of our company and we hire employee-owners. We welcome you to learn more about how we support employees.

* We’re 100% employee owned. Retirement benefits include an employer funded stock ownership plan (ESOP) and personal 401(k) options.
* We offer top tier medical, prescription, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance.
* We recognize the importance of a healthy life balance and offer: 10 paid holidays, annual vacation accrual starting at 12 days, 9 paid sick days, and paid family and medical leave that covers 90% of your pay.
* We foster growth and development of our employees through avenues such as STEM courses, apprenticeships, tuition assistance, and engineering development programs.
* Ask our team about other benefits including wellness, fertility, adoption, and flexible spending benefits.

**Pay Range:** $33.00 - $50.00 per hour

We set starting pay based on job-related factors such as your experience, training, knowledge, and skills. We are looking to fill this position at the Associate Business Intelligence Analyst level, and we welcome applicants with a range of experience. Depending on your background, we may consider you for a different level, with compensation aligned accordingly.

**Communication with Applicants**

We communicate with all applicants. If you do not receive a response about your application, please check your SPAM filter or reach out to us at [careers@selinc.com](mailto:careers@selinc.com).

SEL is an Equal Opportunity Employer: Vets/Disabled.

  

SEL invents, designs, and builds digital products and systems that protect power grids around the world. This technology prevents blackouts and enables customers to improve power system reliability and safety at a reduced cost. A 100 percent employee-owned company headquartered in Pullman, Washington, SEL has manufactured products in the United States since 1984 and now serves customers worldwide. Our mission is simple: to make electric power safer, more reliable, and more economical.

POSITION: Business Intelligence Analyst

FULL-TIME/PART-TIME: Full Time

LOCATION: Bothell, WA - Hybrid

React Health is a fast-paced, growth-driven manufacturer and distributor of medical equipment, dedicated to supporting patients, caregivers, physicians, and healthcare providers. With a focus on respiratory and sleep health sectors, we offer a comprehensive range of products and services across acute care, non-acute care, and home medical equipment. By integrating manufacturing and distribution, React Health addresses the needs of both undiagnosed individuals and those requiring therapy after diagnosis, particularly within the sleep and respiratory care sectors.

GENERAL SUMMARY

The Business Intelligence Analyst will play a pivotal role in supporting data-informed decision-making across our organization. This position will encompass both analytical and development responsibilities - gathering, analyzing, and interpreting business operations data to generate actionable insights, while also designing and maintaining the data infrastructure, pipelines, and BI solutions that enable reporting and analytics at scale.

QUALIFICATIONS

• At least 2 years of experience in the same or similar role.

• Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.

• Experience with business intelligence/data analytics tools (Microsoft Power BI, Tableau, etc.)and proficiency in SQL including complex queries, stored procedures, and performance tuning.

• Experience building or maintaining ETL/ELT pipelines and familiarity with data warehouse concepts and tools (e.g., Snowflake, Databricks, dbt, or similar).

Preferred Education

• Master’s degree in related field

Preferred Experience

• Medical / health industry experience

• Experience with NetSuite

• Working proficiency in Python or R for data manipulation, automation, and analysis (e.g., pandas, numpy, or equivalent libraries).

• Excellent attention to detail and project management skills.

• Excellent written/oral communication skills required. Must be able to work effectively with diverse groups of people.

Physical Demands

• Requires normal visual acuity and hearing.

• Typically, employees sit comfortably to do their work, interspersed by brief periods of standing, walking, bending, carrying papers and books, and extensive periods requiring the use of computer terminals to accomplish work objectives.

• Required to sit and use their hands and fingers to handle or feel and manipulate keys on a keyboard.

• Additional skills may be required to perform additional task(s) specific to work location, department or line of business.

Working Conditions

• Predominantly operates in an office environment. Some work (less than 5%) requires moving and lifting of computer or networking equipment.

DUTIES AND ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

Each Employee consistently demonstrates the following essential functions:

• Perform data analysis to gain insights into various aspects of business performance, including revenue generation, customer behavior, market trends, and operational excellence.

• Support the assessment of the effectiveness of business strategies and initiatives by providing data-driven insights and recommendations for optimization.

• Analyze metrics related to business growth and customer retention, identifying patterns and opportunities for improvement.

• Conduct analyses to identify root causes behind business challenges and contribute to proposing actionable solutions for improvement.

• Development of visually appealing dashboards and data visualizations using industry-standard tools to present key business metrics and insights.

• Assist in creating interactive visualizations that enable stakeholders to explore data and gain actionable insights to inform decision-making.

• Support the design and maintenance of dashboards and reports to monitor performance across various business functions, such as sales, finance, and operations.

• Write and optimize complex SQL queries, stored procedures, and data models to extract, transform, and prepare data from multiple source systems.

• Design, build, and maintain ETL/ELT data pipelines to ensure reliable, timely, and accurate data delivery from source systems to the data warehouse or reporting layer.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and assist in translating them into meaningful data insights and visualization solutions.

• Support documentation efforts by capturing methodologies, data sources, and key findings to establish a comprehensive knowledge base for business intelligence.

• Participate in knowledge-sharing sessions with stakeholders to enhance their understanding of data insights and contribute to fostering a data-driven culture within the organization.

• Attends and participates in departmental meetings. Attends seminars and training sessions necessary to maintain appropriate level of professional competence. Ensures all department compliance guidelines are met.

• Attends all meetings, in-services training, or continuing education as delegated by the supervisor.

• Provides customer focused interactions.

• Performs all duties necessary for the department as per department policies and procedures.

• Performs other duties and responsibilities as delegated by the supervisor within the scope of practice and the responsibilities in the department.

Reasonable accommodations may be made to accommodate individuals with disabilities to perform the basic functions of the position without compromising client care. React Health is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer and is committed to providing a drug-free workplace. Walla Walla Community College (WWCC) is seeking applicants for a **full-time Business Intelligence Analyst** position at the Walla Walla campus.   
  
At Walla Walla Community College, we inspire all students to discover their potential and achieve their goals by providing relevant, equitable, and innovative learning opportunities and services. As an organization, we value learning opportunities, a sense of community, diversity, health and humor, excellence, integrity, teamwork, innovation, personal and professional growth, and sustainability.  
  
In accordance with the AFT-WWPS Collective Bargaining Agreement, Article 15.5, qualified **internal applicants will receive priority consideration on applications received by October 12, 2026, at 11:59 p.m. PST**. If no qualified internal applicant is selected, complete applications from **external candidates received by October 26, 2026, at 11:59 p.m. PST** will be reviewed and considered. External applicants are encouraged to apply and should submit a complete application by this date to ensure full consideration.   
  
**This position will remain open and accepting applications until filled.**   
  
**General Description:**   
The Business Intelligence Analyst (BIA) is a member of the Institutional Research and Effectiveness (IRE) team and plays a key role in supporting institutional planning, decision-making, and continuous improvement. The department supports the college’s mission and commitment to student learning and success by providing quality, accessible, reliable, and relevant information to stakeholders across the institution. Through data analysis, reporting, and research, the department informs decision-making and planning, enhances institutional effectiveness, and fosters a culture of evidence-based inquiry.  
  
Working under the direction of the Director of Institutional Research and Effectiveness, this position collaborates with Business Systems Analysts, Technology Services, Enrollment Strategies, and other stakeholders to transform institutional data into actionable insights. Through interactive dashboards, visualizations, reports, and analyses, the BIA translates complex data into information that is accessible to diverse audiences. The position helps stakeholders understand not only what the data show, but why it matters, revealing trends, patterns, and underlying factors that support informed decision-making and institutional improvement.  
  
*The position is 50% grant funded through Sept 30, 2028 and will be fully institutionalized and funded by the college by the close of the grant cycle.*  
  
**Essential Functions:**   
**Data Visualization**  

* Generates clear, compelling, and accessible visualizations that enable users to explore data, identify trends, and draw meaningful conclusions using the department's primary visualization platform, Power BI. The department is completing a transition from Tableau to Power BI; familiarity with Power BI is essential, and Tableau experience is a plus.
* Adapts the visualization format based on the needs and comprehension levels of multiple audiences, from operational staff to executive leadership.

**Strategic Analysis**  

* Interprets data, identifies meaningful trends and patterns, and develops recommendations for the Director of Institutional Research and Effectiveness and other stakeholders.
* Collaborates closely with multiple departments to identify opportunities for process improvement and reporting.
* Reports on institutional and grant key performance indicators.
* Produces and presents reports on student success (e.g., credit accumulation, retention, and completion), demographics, educational interventions, and other subjects as required. Reports may require the use of advanced statistical analysis and require comparison between cohorts based on specific variables.

**Data Management**  

* Extracts, cleans, validates, and manages data from a variety of sources, systems, and formats.
* Queries data in a complex, multi-table database using SQL, R, and/or other languages.
* Assures data quality and integrity by implementing relevant validation techniques.

**Technical Support and Collaboration**  

* Offers technical expertise and support to other departments as needed.
* Works closely with Technology Services and other data-related departments to achieve strategic objectives.

**Miscellaneous**  

* Helps foster a culture of inquiry, improvement, and evidence-based decision-making.
* Represents the department on collegewide committees and/or project-based working groups, as appropriate.
* Other duties as assigned.

* **Equitable Approaches**: Demonstrates commitment to and understanding of diversity, equity, and inclusion, specifically through how data and research can shape and be shaped by such issues.
* **Analytical Prowess**: Demonstrates strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify trends, uncover root causes, evaluate outcomes, and develop actionable recommendations. Applies appropriate quantitative and qualitative methods to support institutional planning, decision-making, continuous improvement, and student success.
* **Communication and Data Storytelling**: Demonstrates outstanding written, verbal, and visual communication skills, including the ability to translate complex data and technical concepts for diverse audiences. Produces high-quality analyses, reports, dashboards, presentations, and other deliverables that communicate findings clearly and effectively. Uses data storytelling techniques to convey insights, provide context, and support informed decision-making.
* **Project Management**: Demonstrates the ability to plan, organize, prioritize, and manage multiple projects simultaneously. Establishes timelines, coordinates stakeholders, monitors progress, and ensures deliverables are completed accurately and on schedule.
* **Technological Fluency: Demonstrates familiarity with data integration, cloud-based data environments, data warehousing concepts, and business intelligence platforms.**
* **Adaptability**: Demonstrates the ability to work independently and collaboratively in a dynamic environment with shifting priorities, evolving institutional needs, and competing deadlines. Remains flexible and responsive while maintaining accuracy, professionalism, and attention to detail.
* **Responsible Use of Artificial Intelligence**: Understands the responsible and ethical use of artificial intelligence, including generative AI tools, in research, analysis, and reporting. Applies appropriate professional judgment regarding suitable use cases, data privacy and governance, and the protection of sensitive and student-level data. Maintains human review and validation of AI-assisted outputs and demonstrates awareness of bias, accuracy, transparency, and reproducibility considerations.
* **Interdisciplinary Collaboration**: Demonstrates the ability to build effective working relationships across departments and functional areas. Collaborates with stakeholders to understand information needs, develop solutions, and advance institutional goals.
* **Ethical Standards:** Demonstrates ethics, integrity, and sound professional judgment. The department adheres to the [ethical principles of the Association for Institutional Research](https://www.airweb.org/ir-data-professional-overview/statement-of-ethical-principles/principles) (AIR).

  
**Level of Supervision**  
**Level 1 — General supervision — Advice and assistance is available as needed. Review of work may be frequent but generally not detailed. Emphasis placed upon quality of completed assignments.**

* Performs recurring assignments without daily oversight following established guidelines, policies, procedures and work methods.
* Responsible for prioritizing day-to-day work tasks. Supervisor provides guidance and approves deviation from established guidelines, policies, procedures and work methods.
* Decision-making is limited in context to the completion of work tasks. Completed work is consistent with established guidelines, policies, procedures and work methods. Supervisory guidance is provided in new or unusual situations.
* May develop procedures for performance of a variety of duties within the scope of the position.
* Performs complex duties within established guidelines.
* Work is periodically reviewed for compliance with guidelines, policies and procedures.

**Level 2 — General direction — Position receives broad instruction. Advice and assistance is available upon request. Review of work generally emphasizes accomplishment of broader work unit goals and/or performance measures in lieu of specific work assignments.**

* Independently performs all assignments using knowledge of established policies and work objectives with minimal direct oversight from supervisor.
* Plans and organizes work and assists in determining priorities and deadlines. May deviate from standard work methods, guidelines or procedures in order to meet work objectives.
* Exercises independent decision-making authority and discretion and determines which work methods to use, tasks to perform and procedures to follow in order to meet work objectives.
* Completed work is reviewed for effectiveness in producing expected results.
* Establishes procedures for attaining specific goals and objectives in a broad area of work.

  
**Required Qualifications:**   
*Any combination of education, experience, and/or training that provides the applicant with the knowledge and skills to perform the job may be considered by the college.*  *Must reside in either WA, OR, ID, CA, IL, PA, or TX if selected for remote work.*   
This position is designed to be filled at either a level 1 or 2 depending on qualifications.

* **Level 1 Requirements:**
    * Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Sociology or related field; OR equivalent combination of education/experience.
    * Demonstrable intermediate to advanced expertise in data manipulation and visualization tools, particularly Power BI.
    * Intermediate to advanced proficiency querying relational databases, such as Oracle and MS SQL. Experience with ctcLink/PeopleSoft or a similar ERP system preferred.
    * Bilingual in English and Spanish preferred.
* **Level 2 Requirements:**
    * Bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Sociology or related field AND advanced expertise in data manipulation and visualization tools, particularly Power BI, and in a statistical programming language such as R or Python; OR an equivalent combination of education and experience. Master’s degree preferred.

  
***You don’t check every qualification listed? Please apply anyway!*** *Studies have shown that traditionally marginalized communities - such as women, LGBTQ+ and people of color - are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification - even if they might be a great fit for the role! If you’re excited about this opportunity but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every single qualification in the job description, we encourage you to still consider applying.* This position is in a bargaining unit for which AFT is the exclusive representative.  
  
This is a full-time, possibly overtime eligible professional position. Persons hired must be able to provide acceptable documentation of lawful authorization to work in the United States within three (3) days of employment. WWCC participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S. Official college transcripts required at time of hire. Candidates may be subject to a criminal history background check as a condition of employment. Information from the background check may not necessarily preclude employment but will be considered in determining the applicant’s suitability and competence to perform in the position. The college is a tobacco free institution.  
  
Work is performed in an indoor, multi-level office setting; sitting at a desk or computer station, light lifting may be required. Exposure to hazards is limited to those commonly found in office environments. This contract position work schedule will typically be Monday through Friday 8-hours each day. During the summer, work schedule is Monday through Thursday 10-hours each day. Some travel may be required, and is typically local or regional for training.  
  
The College’s preference is for regular, on-site, and in-office presence. However, a hybrid-remote work arrangement may be considered for a highly qualified candidate. While the College gives preference to candidates residing in Oregon, Washington, or Idaho due to operational considerations, candidates from other locations may also be considered.  
  
Any hybrid-remote arrangement is contingent upon consistent, demonstrated engagement on Teams, Zoom, and email during regular business hours and may be modified or revoked at any time should it no longer meet the operational needs of the College. In-person attendance is required for the first two days of onboarding and may be required for other key meetings, trainings, or events as determined by the College. All travel costs associated with required on-site presence under a hybrid-remote arrangement are the responsibility of the employee.  
  
**Compensation:**  
Annual salary range for initial placement based on the represented exempt salary schedule is **PR05, Step A-F: $72,343 - $81,850 for Level 1, OR PR06, Step A-F: $75,960 - $85,942 for Level 2**, with scheduled salary increment increases every 12 months until you reach the top of the scale. The college has an excellent benefit program including paid sick leave; paid vacation leave; medical, dental, life, and long-term disability insurance; retirement and two optional deferred compensation programs. All full-time employees will automatically have 3% of taxable income deferred into the State of Washington Deferred Compensation Program (DCP). All administrative exempt staff set aside 1% of their gross salary in a Health Reimbursement Arrangement (HRA) (VEBA). All exempt employees are required to participate in this program. Walla Walla Community College requires all employees to participate in direct deposit for payment of salary.This position is open until filled with priority consideration given to those applicants who submit a complete application by **October 12, 2026 (for internal applications), and** **October 26, 2026 (for external applications), at 11:59 PM PST**. To qualify for priority consideration, applicants must submit a complete application packet, which includes the following:

* Online NEOGOV application.
* Cover letter
    * Provide a cover letter detailing your interest in this position. Please describe any professional experience, training, or educational background that makes you an ideal candidate.
* Resume
* Names and contact information for three professional references
* Answers to two (2) supplemental questions
* Unofficial transcripts for application purposes; official transcripts are required prior to an official start date.

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight! 

This role is part of Blue Origin corporate functions, providing centralized support across Blue Origin business unit teams, functions, and locations.

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. Join our diverse team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight.

  

This role is part of Blue Origin Corporate Functions on the Finance AI & BI team and will be on-site in Renton, Washington with relocation provided.

  

We are seeking a Senior Business Intelligence Analyst to own the strategy and roadmap for the suite of BI tools supporting Finance and Accounting, including capital, labor, and inventory/production reporting today, with the expectation that this portfolio will grow. This is a senior, high-autonomy role: you will set direction for how existing tools evolve, lead build-vs-integrate decisions with Enterprise Technology (ET) and other cross-functional partners, and identify where new BI tools should be built to close reporting or controls gaps as the business scales. You will also mentor other analysts and represent Finance and Accounting BI needs in broader enterprise data and systems discussions.

  

**Responsibilities include but are not limited to:**

* Own the execution of Finance and Accounting's BI tool portfolio, currently including Capital Management and In-Servicing, Labor Reporting, and Production web application with expansion to new tools as reporting or controls needs are identified
* Partner with ET to determine what logic belongs in business intelligence vs. source systems and lead automation of inventory reconciliations and costing sheet rate monitoring
* Lead the design of automated logic, using transaction detail and accounting guidance to flag and correct transactions, and drive upstream error-prevention to reduce reliance on manual corrections
* Identify gaps in existing Finance and Accounting reporting and lead the design and build of new BI tools to address them
* Set priorities for the BI roadmap with Finance, Accounting, and ET leadership, and represent Finance and Accounting BI needs in enterprise data governance discussions
* Mentor and provide technical guidance to other BI analysts and supporting their development

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business or Data Analytics, Data Science, Information Systems, or related field
* 8+ years in business intelligence or systems analysis, ideally supporting a Finance or Accounting function
* Demonstrated experience owning BI tool strategy and roadmap with full autonomy, including building new tools or reporting solutions from the ground up
* Advanced proficiency in Power BI, Tableau, or equivalent, and advanced SQL knowledge
* Working knowledge of cost accounting concepts (e.g., capital projects, labor allocation, or inventory costing), with the ability to quickly learn Blue Origin-specific policies and processes
* Track record of leading cross-functional initiatives, influencing senior stakeholders, and mentoring other analysts

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Strong working knowledge of cost accounting concepts, particularly capital project accounting or manufacturing cost accounting
* Familiarity with ERP/cloud data platforms (Microsoft Dynamics 365, OneStream, Databricks, etc) and proficiency with Python or R for automation/advanced analytics
* Experience with data warehousing, ETL workflow design, or applying AI/ML to automate error detection at scale
* Experience driving enterprise-wide data governance or standardization initiatives

###

WA applicants is $145,188.00 - $203,263.20

* Required for Certain Job Profiles: Drivers who operate Commercial Motor Vehicles with a Gross Vehicle Weight (GVW), Gross Vehicle Weight Rating (GVWR) or combination of power unit and trailer that meets or exceeds 10,001 lbs. and/or transports placardable amounts of hazardous materials by ground in any vehicle on a public road while in commerce, may be subject to additional Federal Motor Carrier Safety Regulations including: Driver Qualification Files, Medical Certification (obtained before onboarding), Road Test, Hours of Service, Drug and Alcohol Testing, vehicle inspection requirements, CDL requirements (if applicable) and hazardous materials transportation/shipping training.

**Benefits**

* Benefits include:  Medical, dental, vision, basic and supplemental life insurance, paid parental leave, short and long-term disability, 401(k) with a company match of up to 5%, and an Education Support Program.
* Stock Options for all regular employees (working at least 20 hours/week)
* Paid Time Off:  Up to four (4) weeks per year based on weekly scheduled hours, and up to 14 company-paid holidays.
* Dependent on role type and job level, employees may be eligible for benefits and bonuses based on the company's intent to reward individual contributions and enable them to share in the company's results, or other factors at the company's sole discretion. Bonus amounts and eligibility are not guaranteed and subject to change and cancellation. Please check with your recruiter for more details.

  

**Equal Employment Opportunity**

Blue Origin is proud to be an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer and is committed to attracting, retaining, and developing a highly qualified and dedicated work force. Blue Origin hires and promotes people on the basis of their qualifications, performance, and abilities. We provide all qualified applicants for employment and employees with equal opportunities for hire, promotion, and other terms and conditions of employment, regardless of their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin/ethnicity, age, physical or mental disability, genetic factors, military/veteran status, or any other status or characteristic protected by federal, state, and/or local law. Blue Origin will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws, including the Washington Fair Chance Act, the California Fair Chance Act, the Los Angeles Fair Chance in Hiring Ordinance, and other applicable laws. We’re committed to building the road to space so our children can build the future. We are a mission-driven company focused on ideas and innovation, and encourage fresh perspectives from bold voices. ## **FEP Business Intelligence Analyst I**

Hybrid role (3 days/week in office) at our Portland, Vancouver, Renton, Salt Lake City, Boise, Little Rock, Springdale, Fargo, Medford, Burlington, and Lewiston offices. Candidates must reside within commutable distance of that location or be willing to relocate.

**Build a career with purpose. Join our** [**Cause**](https://www.cambiahealth.com/about-us/our-cause-values/values-ethics-compliance) **to create a person-focused and economically sustainable health care system.**

**Who We Are Looking For:**

Every day, Cambia’s dedicated team of FEP Business Intelligence Analysts is living our mission to make health care easier and lives better. As a member of the FEP Data Analytics team, our FEP Business Intelligence Analysts build FEP analytics, ad-hoc reports, and Sigma or Tableau dashboards using Python for scripting; analysis of claims, customer service, and clinical data; manage projects, communicate with stakeholders, and collaborate cross-departmentally to meet varied deadlines– all in service of creating an economically sustainable health care system.

Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment where collaboration and flexibility are key? Are you energized by turning data into insights that help shape better health plan operations? Then this role may be the perfect fit.

**What You Bring to Cambia:**

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Information Technology, Economics, or a related field
* 3+ years of related work experience
* An equivalent combination of education and experience will be considered

**Skills and Attributes:**

* SQL proficiency (complex queries for standard and ad hoc data mining); candidates without SQL experience must demonstrate strength in other listed areas
* Microsoft Excel skills
* Scripting and statistical tools experience, such as Python, R/RStudio, SSIS, Alteryx, and Talend
* Data visualization and reporting tools experience, such as Tableau, MicroStrategy, SPSS, and Power BI
* Interactive dashboard development for data exploration, self-service analytics, and visual storytelling
* Broad data analysis experience across datasets such as demographics, workflow, financial, and healthcare data
* Large-scale data analysis, including interpreting qualitative data (research, feedback) and incorporating it into analyses
* Research and methodology skills, with the ability to develop data mining approaches and innovative statistical or mathematical methods
* Experience with AI tools and technologies to enhance productivity and decision-making (highly desired)
* Whole-brain thinking: creative and analytical problem-solving, both independently and on teams, with the ability to learn quickly and synthesize solutions, options, and action plans
* Collaboration skills to partner with team members and business stakeholders to define, develop, and deliver analytics that support routine operations, tactical decisions, and strategic direction

* Independent work with strong management of deliverable timelines and clients
* Accuracy and quality focus, producing error-free deliverables and supporting a peer review culture

**What You Will Do at Cambia:**

Learn more about our [benefits](https://www.cambiahealth.com/careers/total-rewards).

  

We are happy to offer work from home options for most of our roles. Position Summary
The Revenue Cycle Financial & Business Intelligence Analyst is a hybrid role combining revenue cycle financial analysis, operational performance optimization, business intelligence development, and advanced workflow automation.
This position serves as the primary analytics and reporting partner to the VP of Revenue Cycle while operating within the Analytics Department. The role is responsible for analyzing revenue cycle performance, identifying financial and operational improvement opportunities, and developing reporting solutions using SQL and Qlik.
In addition, this position serves as the subject matter expert for Revenue Cycle automation and process optimization within Microsoft Power Automate, SharePoint, and Microsoft Lists, driving structured workflow improvements and reducing manual reporting processes.
Must have strong Revenue Cycle experience, paired with solid technical skills and ideally within provider specific healthcare setting.
Schedule
1.0 FTE, Monday - Friday.
Key Duties and Responsibilities
The key duties and responsibilities of the Revenue Cycle Financial & Business Intelligence Analyst include, but are not limited to:
Revenue Cycle Financial & Operational Analysis

Analyze revenue cycle data to identify trends, anomalies, and areas for financial and operational improvement.
Identify trends in revenue cycle performance and proactively address potential issues or opportunities.
Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) related to revenue cycle performance and report findings to management.
Conduct regular audits to ensure compliance with billing and coding regulations and guidelines.
Stay current on industry trends, regulations, and technologies related to revenue cycle management.
Work with Revenue Cycle leaders to develop and implement strategies to streamline revenue cycle processes and maximize revenue generation.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify root causes of revenue cycle inefficiencies and help implement corrective actions.

Business Intelligence Development & Reporting Support

Write SQL queries to extract, transform, validate, and analyze revenue cycle data from the enterprise data warehouse.
Develop and maintain revenue cycle dashboards and reporting applications within Qlik.
Serve as backup and supplemental support for all revenue cycle Qlik applications and reporting assets.
Fulfill ad hoc reporting and analytical requests using SQL and Excel.
Partner with the Analytics team in maintaining revenue cycle data structures within the SQL data warehouse.
Ensure reporting accuracy, consistency, and alignment with enterprise metric definitions.

Advanced Automation & Workflow Optimization (Required Expertise)

Serve as the revenue cycle subject matter expert for Microsoft Power Automate.
Design, build, and maintain advanced automated workflows to improve reporting intake, tracking, approvals, and operational efficiency.
Develop and manage structured reporting solutions using SharePoint and Microsoft Lists.
Create scalable process automation tools that reduce manual intervention and improve data transparency.
Identify and implement automation opportunities that improve turnaround time, compliance, and reporting reliability.

Training & Collaboration

Provide training and support to revenue cycle staff on reporting tools, automation solutions, best practices, and procedural changes.
Collaborate with Analytics, Finance, IT, and Revenue Cycle leadership to ensure alignment on reporting priorities and definitions.
Support enterprise-wide ad hoc analytics initiatives as part of the Analytics team.

Education/Experience

Bachelor’s degree in Healthcare Administration, Business Administration, Finance, Data Analytics, Information Systems, or related field preferred.
Proven experience in revenue cycle management, healthcare finance, or related field.
Intermediate SQL proficiency required (ability to write multi-table joins, aggregations, filtering logic, and performance-aware queries).
Demonstrated experience building applications within a BI platform; Qlik experience strongly preferred.
Advanced experience with Microsoft Power Automate required.
Advanced working knowledge of SharePoint and Microsoft Lists required.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex financial and operational data sets.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including pivot tables, formulas, and structured data analysis.
Knowledge of healthcare billing and coding regulations preferred.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.

title.value: Business Intelligence Analyst II, Finance & Administration - #Staff

description.value:
The Business Intelligence Analyst II will support the Development and Alumni Relations Finance and Administration team by acquiring, transforming, analyzing, and reporting financial and operational data. The Analyst will maintain and improve automation processes and Power BI dashboards that support financial reporting, planning, reconciliations, and decision-making. The Analyst will partner with finance leadership and staff to define data needs, troubleshoot existing workflows, and develop reliable tools and visualizations.
Reporting to the Sr. Finance Project Manager, the Analyst will coordinate with central data and technology teams as needed to ensure that finance data and reporting processes are accurate, documented, and aligned with University standards. The Analyst will also support finance data preparation, validation, and reporting.
The Business Intelligence Analyst II is responsible for data analytics and additional support for performance measures, ongoing measurement, data collection, reporting, data visualizations, and information dissemination. Responsible for participating in the strategic design and maintenance of business intelligence applications. The Business Intelligence Analyst II will identify, research, and resolve technical problems. The Business Intelligence Analyst II will ensure that the use of business intelligence applications enhances clinical and/or business decision-making capabilities. The Business Intelligence Analyst II will work on limited to moderately complex projects and gain exposure to more complex tasks within the job function. The Business Intelligence Analyst II will work under the supervision of a Data Trust Analytic Team Leader or other data governance or analytic leadership appropriate for the scope of work. This supervision may be through a matrixed or direct reporting structure.
Specific Duties & Responsibilities:
+ Responsible for data analytics and additional support for performance measures, ongoing measurement, data collection, reporting, data visualizations, and information dissemination.
+ Responsible for participating in the strategic design and maintenance of business intelligence applications.
+ Identify, research, and resolve technical problems.
+ Ensure that the use of business intelligence applications enhances clinical and/or business decision-making capabilities.
+ Make appropriate decisions using available resources to achieve positive outcomes for patients, visitors, and staff in balance with sound business practice.
+ Make recommendations for changes in the current departmental systems and processes and contribute ideas and suggestions for solutions to problems.
+ Report and follow-up on software problems delaying workflow.
+ Respond to urgent, impromptu, and unplanned situations by assessing their level of importance, instituting appropriate action, and appropriately managing information and communication.
+ Communicate decisions to appropriate management.
+ Prepare incident/occurrence reports as necessary.
+ Prioritize daily tasks and assignments appropriately.
+ Complete mandatory Epic and other software or analytic tool training as required.
+ Collaborate with other analytic teams as directed.
+ Other duties as assigned.
In addition to the duties listed above the Business Intelligence Analyst II will:
+ Maintain, troubleshoot, document, and enhance Python scripts used by DAR Finance for recurring reporting, reconciliations, budget and forecast preparation, personnel cost analysis, allocations, and other finance workflows.
+ Acquire, integrate, cleanse, transform, and validate data from general ledger, budget, payroll, procurement, expense, and other enterprise sources for Finance; reconcile outputs to authoritative financial records.
+ Develop and maintain DAR Finance's Power BI data models, Power Query transformations, DAX measures, refresh processes, reports, and dashboards supporting budget-to-actual, forecast, fund balance, personnel cost, and transaction analysis.
+ Establish Finance data-quality and governance standards, including financial mappings, metric definitions, reconciliations, documentation, version control, and repeatable controls for consistent, auditable reporting.
Minimum Qualifications
+ Bachelor’s degree in a related field.
+ Three years of experience in a professional environment using the relevant knowledge base and skills. A minimum of two years collecting and analyzing data, preparing reports, identifying and solving problems.
+ Additional education may substitute for required experience and additional related experience may substitute for required education permitted by the JHU equivalency formula beyond a high school diploma/graduation equivalent, to the extent permitted by the JHU equivalency formula.
Preferred Qualifications
+ Proficiency in Python for data transformation, automation, and troubleshooting; proficiency in Microsoft Power BI, including Power Query, DAX, data modeling, and dashboard development; and proficiency in Microsoft Excel, with demonstrated experience applying finance or accounting concepts to budgets, forecasts, reconciliations, and variance analysis.
+ Professional background in financial planning and analysis, accounting, or higher education finance.
